Implement the ODS in an existing product


Two themes facilitating a seamless transition

The One DS offers two default themes: the One DS Base Theme, aligned with our prior design language, e.g. reflected in Scale, and the One DS Theme, embodying the new One Experience Identity. The One DS Base Library will be accessible during a transition phase. As major products adopt the Design System with the new identity, we will gradually phase it out.

Explore the rationale behind having two themes
A) Start with One DS Base Library to prepare under the hood

Navigating the intricacies of a complex product poses the challenge of avoiding inconsistencies across various flows in front of your users. To address this, consider a strategic approach by initially rebuilding your screens using our One ID base library, aligning seamlessly with the scale design system. Whether you choose to progress component by component or flow by flow is up to you. The beauty of this approach lies in its flexibility, adapting to the unique needs and pace of your project. By implementing the One ID base library first, you can meticulously prepare, mitigating the risk of significant inconsistencies creeping into your product.
Once this foundational step is complete, the transition becomes straightforward. A swap of libraries allows you to update your entire product to embrace the refreshed visual identity . However, it's important to anticipate some manual rework of screens to harmonize content, given that e.g. the size of components and utilization of whitepace differ from how we did before. In essence, our approach provides the flexibility needed for your unique circumstances, ensuring a meticulous transition to a revitalized visual identity without compromising the integrity of your intricate product.

B) Launch on the Big Bang journey directly using the One DS Library

If your product, along with its release cycles and team availability, permits, you have the option to rework your interfaces using the components from the One DS library. Anticipate a significant leap forward in visual design. However, it's important to note that this process goes beyond a mere component update; variations in sizing and the utilization of space should be considered and some manual work should be expected.
For an immersive encounter with the enhanced Telekome One Experience, we recommend contemplating a refinement of the flows themselves, aligning with the corresponding guidelines. This holistic approach ensures a harmonious integration of the new design elements, delivering a seamless and elevated user experience.

If you decide to start with the Base Theme
Implementing a new design system requires manual effort, as swapping libraries from different design systems isn't feasible due to naming and component structure differences. To streamline this process, we provide the following guidance:

Duplicate your layout file and clearly rename the new one (e.g., "myProduct XY - One DS.fig").
Enable Libraries:
a) Base Foundation
b) ODS Base Components Web or ODS Base Components Mobile
c) Icon Library

Select the instance you want to replace within your library:Tip: For larger files with multiple instances to replace, utilize the Quick Actions menu by typing "select all with same properties." Figma will automatically select all instances of the chosen component. However, manual refactoring may still be necessary for most components after replacement.

Figma will display the name of the selected component in the instance section of the right sidebar. Select "ODS Base Components Mobile or ODS Base Components Web" by clicking on the displayed library name in the right sidebar.

Use the flyout menu to navigate through components. Select the new component you want to use as a replacement.

Your overrides may be reset, so review and replace content as needed.

Apply text styles to all texts and spacing tokens to your layout.

Consider the process complete once all components across your product are linked to the ODS base library and text styles are applied universally.

To update your product to the new One Experience Identity, swap Libraries from the e.g. ODS Base Components Web to ODS One ID Components Web to the ODS library. Note that components will not be reset, but manual adjustments will be required.
